name: Zamah's Note
summary: Zamah's Note carries an urgent plea from Thunder Bluff to Tarren Mill. Zamah asks Apothecary Lydon for an alchemical way to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon without direct bloodshed.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Great Sea
sections.body: The Venture Company has dug deep into the Stonetalon Mountains, felling trees and tearing up sacred land. Zamah wants a way to force the goblins out without slaughter. She turns to the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society for help. Her note tells her colleague, Apothecary Lydon, about the danger in Stonetalon. Lydon is in Tarren Mill, far away in the Hillsbrad Foothills of Lordaeron.

sections.title: Apothecary Connections
sections.body: The sealed note must cross continents to reach Lydon. Travelers from Kalimdor take a zeppelin to the Undercity, then travel south through Silverpine Forest into Hillsbrad. Lydon is intrigued by Zamah's specific request. Word has reached him from across the ocean, and he prepares an alchemical answer to the goblin problem.

faq.answer: Zamah's Note is a sealed letter from Thunder Bluff to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. It asks for an alchemical formula to remove the Venture Company from Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why does Zamah need help from Tarren Mill?
faq.answer: Zamah wants to drive the goblins out of Stonetalon without bloodshed. She asks Apothecary Lydon because the Forsaken alchemists make specialized concoctions for subtle disruptions.

faq.q: Where does the note need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the note
faq.answer: The note must reach Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, in the Hillsbrad Foothills of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Who is the Venture Company mentioned in the note?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin-run mining and logging syndicate. It clear-cuts forests, exploits natural resources, and pollutes lands across Kalimdor, including the sacred peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains.

angles.text: The note's delivery shows how the Horde's distant capitals across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms share routes and resources.
As an undead, you belong to a people whose Royal Apothecary Society offers specialized chemical expertise to allies facing difficult crises.
